description: Conservation of RNA-contact-equivalent positions across fungal MKRN-like tandem CCCH proteins (InterPro IPR045072)
code:
import requests, re, numpy as np, pandas as pd
from collections import Counter
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
H={"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"}

mem=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniref/UniRef50_Q02799/members",
                 params={"format":"json","size":500},headers=H,timeout=120).json()
ids=[(m.get("memberId"),m.get("organismName")) for m in mem.get("results",[])]
print("UniRef50_Q02799 members:")
for i,o in ids: print("  ",i,"|",o)

# broaden: UniProt text search on PANTHER subfamily + fungi, plus BLAST-free homolog pull via UniParc is not available.
# Use UniProt search for the MKRN-like family (InterPro IPR045072) restricted to Fungi, short proteins (<400 aa, i.e. no RING).
q='(xref:interpro-IPR045072) AND (taxonomy_id:4751) AND (length:[150 TO 450])'
r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/stream",
   params={"query":q,"format":"fasta","size":500},headers=H,timeout=300)
seqs={}; nm=None
for ln in r.text.split("\n"):
    if ln.startswith(">"):
        nm=ln[1:]; seqs[nm]=""
    elif nm: seqs[nm]+=ln.strip()
print("\nFungal IPR045072 (MKRN-like) proteins 150-450 aa retrieved:",len(seqs))

pat=re.compile(r'C.{4,15}?C.{3,8}?C.{3,4}?H')
def fingers(s):
    out=[];p=0
    while True:
        m=pat.search(s,p)
        if not m: break
        mm=re.match(r'C(.{4,15}?)C(.{3,8}?)C(.{3,4}?)H',m.group(0))
        out.append(dict(start=m.start()+1,end=m.end(),sp=(len(mm.group(1)),len(mm.group(2)),len(mm.group(3))),motif=m.group(0)))
        p=m.end()
    return out

POS=['C1','C1+1','C1+2','C1+3','C1+4','C1+5','C1+6','C1+7','C2','C2+1','C2+2','C2+3','C2+4','C2+5','C3','C3+1','C3+2','C3+3','H']
Z1=[];Z2=[];LNK=[];ORG=[]
for h,s in seqs.items():
    fs=fingers(s); pair=None
    for i in range(len(fs)-1):
        if fs[i]['sp']==(7,5,3) and fs[i+1]['sp']==(7,5,3) and fs[i+1]['start']-fs[i]['end']-1<=25:
            pair=(fs[i],fs[i+1]); break
    if not pair: continue
    a,b=pair
    Z1.append(list(a['motif'])); Z2.append(list(b['motif'])); LNK.append(b['start']-a['end']-1)
    ORG.append(re.search(r'OS=(.*?) (OX=|GN=)',h).group(1) if 'OS=' in h else h[:40])
print("with a C-x7/C-x7 tandem pair:",len(Z1))
print("distinct organisms:",len(set(ORG)))
print("linker lengths:",Counter(LNK).most_common())

lee1={'ZF1':list("CKFFKMGNCQAGSSCPFSH"),'ZF2':list("CKYFAKGNCKFGNKCVNAH")}
W={'C1':2.0,'C1+1':11.0,'C1+2':1.5,'C2':0.0,'C2+1':3.5,'C2+2':36.0,'C2+5':8.5,'C3':4.5,'C3+1':18.0,'C3+2':60.0}
AROM=set('FYW'); BASIC=set('KR')
out=[]
for tag,Z in [('ZF1',Z1),('ZF2',Z2)]:
    df=pd.DataFrame(Z,columns=POS)
    for p in POS:
        cnt=Counter(df[p]); tot=len(df); top,n=cnt.most_common(1)[0]
        out.append(dict(finger=tag,pos=p,LEE1=lee1[tag][POS.index(p)],
                        n_orth=tot,consensus=top,cons_freq=round(n/tot,2),
                        pct_same_as_LEE1=round(cnt[lee1[tag][POS.index(p)]]/tot,2),
                        pct_aromatic=round(sum(v for k,v in cnt.items() if k in AROM)/tot,2),
                        pct_basic=round(sum(v for k,v in cnt.items() if k in BASIC)/tot,2),
                        TIS11d_RNA_contacts=W.get(p,0.0)))
O=pd.DataFrame(out)
pd.set_option('display.width',240)
print("\n=== Conservation across %d fungal MKRN-like tandem-CCCH proteins ==="%len(Z1))
print(O.to_string(index=False))
O.to_csv('lee1_fungal_ortholog_position_conservation.csv',index=False)

key=O[O.TIS11d_RNA_contacts>=8].copy()
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(11,4.6))
x=np.arange(len(key)); w=0.38
ax.bar(x-w/2,key.pct_aromatic,w,label='aromatic (F/Y/W)',color='#5f3dc4')
ax.bar(x+w/2,key.pct_basic,w,label='basic (K/R)',color='#2b8a3e')
for i,(p,l,f,c) in enumerate(zip(key.pos,key.LEE1,key.finger,key.TIS11d_RNA_contacts)):
    ax.text(i,1.02,f"LEE1 {f}\n{l}",ha='center',va='bottom',fontsize=8)
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels([f"{f}\n{p}\n({int(c)} contacts)" for f,p,c in zip(key.finger,key.pos,key.TIS11d_RNA_contacts)],fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylim(0,1.3); ax.set_ylabel("fraction of %d fungal\nMKRN-like homologs"%len(Z1))
ax.set_title("At the positions that read RNA bases in TIS11d, fungal LEE1-type fingers are only\nsporadically aromatic or basic; LEE1 itself keeps one aromatic per finger, never both",fontsize=10)
ax.legend(frameon=False); plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
